title: Shooter Component
description: Ranged weapon component for projectile-based attacks.
content:
Shooter Component

Ranged weapon component for projectile-based attacks, managing fire rate, spread, and burst fire.

Component Weapon

Schema

JSON
"shooterComponent": {
  "projectileEntity": "...",
  "fireRate": 0.0,
  "spread": 0.0,
  "burstCount": 0,
  "burstDelay": 0.0,
  "muzzleOffset": 0.0
}

Description

The ShooterComponent is a ranged weapon component that handles projectile-based attacks. It manages projectile spawning, firing rates, spread patterns, and burst fire mechanics for entities that use ranged combat. This component provides fine-grained control over shooting behavior including muzzle positioning and multi-shot bursts.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
projectileEntitystringThe entity ID of the projectile to fire.
fireRatefloatTime in seconds between shots or bursts.
spreadfloatAngular spread of fired projectiles in degrees.
burstCountintNumber of projectiles fired in a single burst.
burstDelayfloatTime in seconds between each shot within a burst.
muzzleOffsetfloatForward offset from the entity origin where projectiles spawn.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "shooterComponent": {
      "projectileEntity": "plasma_bolt",
      "fireRate": 0.25,
      "spread": 3.0,
      "burstCount": 3,
      "burstDelay": 0.05,
      "muzzleOffset": 1.2
    }
  }
}
